smells.finding: EXECUTE_PLAN.g1-implement.c1's new match={"status": "complete"} treats the implementer-result payload's completion state as a bare, hand-typed string key with no shared vocabulary or schema across producers. r4a's independent sweep of 119 real implementer-result evidence records in .agent-work/ found at least three incompatible conventions in live use (status, verdict, and no field at all, plus case variants), because nothing in this repo defines the payload as a typed contract -- each Commander run invents its own shape. The fix hard-codes one guessed primitive value against an unenforced, undocumented field, which is exactly how primitive obsession bites: a string is standing in for a contract that was never written down anywhere a producer could read it (IMPLEMENTER_RESULT.md's own Out-of-scope section says the same).
